## MGIT Students Excel in Intel Unnathi Summer Internship 2025

News Date : 19 Sep 2025News ReportHyderabad, Sept 2025:The Principal of MGIT, Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy, has initiated a collaboration with Intel through the prestigiousIntel Unnathi Industrial Training Program – Summer Internship 2025. As part of this initiative, two student teams from the CSM Branch, Department of Emerging Technologies, were selected to participate.The first team comprisedSirimilla Karthik Balaji,Khaja Moinuddin Shaik Mohammed, andVedagiri Sai Charan, while the second team includedRadhi T V J,Gopisetty Shashank, andAman Adusumilli. Both teams were mentored byDr. T. V. Rajini Kanth, Professor in Emerging Technologies and Convener of R&D.The internship program, which ran from May to July 2025, provided students with real-world problem statements from thrust areas identified by Intel’s industry experts. Guidance was extended by Intel’s R&D team along with researchers from leading institutes in Bangalore.All participating students successfully completed and submitted their projects, which were evaluated by industry experts. On successful completion, the results were announced and certificates were awarded. Notably, students from top private universities, engineering colleges, and government universities participated in this national-level program.This marks thefirst time MGIT students have taken part in the Intel Unnathi program, with a successful outcome. Appreciating their efforts, Principal Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy congratulated the students and personally distributed the certificates.

Hyderabad, Sept 2025:The Principal of MGIT, Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy, has initiated a collaboration with Intel through the prestigiousIntel Unnathi Industrial Training Program – Summer Internship 2025. As part of this initiative, two student teams from the CSM Branch, Department of Emerging Technologies, were selected to participate.
The first team comprisedSirimilla Karthik Balaji,Khaja Moinuddin Shaik Mohammed, andVedagiri Sai Charan, while the second team includedRadhi T V J,Gopisetty Shashank, andAman Adusumilli. Both teams were mentored byDr. T. V. Rajini Kanth, Professor in Emerging Technologies and Convener of R&D.
The internship program, which ran from May to July 2025, provided students with real-world problem statements from thrust areas identified by Intel’s industry experts. Guidance was extended by Intel’s R&D team along with researchers from leading institutes in Bangalore.
All participating students successfully completed and submitted their projects, which were evaluated by industry experts. On successful completion, the results were announced and certificates were awarded. Notably, students from top private universities, engineering colleges, and government universities participated in this national-level program.
This marks thefirst time MGIT students have taken part in the Intel Unnathi program, with a successful outcome. Appreciating their efforts, Principal Prof. G. Chandramohan Reddy congratulated the students and personally distributed the certificates.
